a.style: position: relative; padding: 8px 20px 8px 15px; margin-left: 10px; border-radius: 50px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #FF914D, #FF7E33); color: white !important; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; transition: all 0.3s ease; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(255,145,77,0.2);

div.style: margin-right: 8px; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;

span.style: top: -4px; right: -4px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: #e91e63; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(233,30,99,0.6);
